<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>SIGNAL // INDIC — Speech LLM Latency Research</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #ffffff;
    --surface: #f8fafc;
    --border: #e2e8f0;
    --slate: #1e293b;
    --mid: #64748b;
    --light: #94a3b8;
    --indigo: #4f46e5;
    --indigo-light: #eef2ff;
    --emerald: #059669;
    --emerald-light: #ecfdf5;
    --amber: #d97706;
    --amber-light: #fffbeb;
    --violet: #7c3aed;
    --violet-light: #f5f3ff;
    --red: #dc2626;
  }
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  body {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--slate);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  a { color: var(--indigo); text-decoration: none; }
  a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

  .wrap { max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px 80px; }

  /* ── HEADER ── */
  .header {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 40px 0 32px;
    margin-bottom: 48px;
  }
  .header-top {
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .project-label {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 2px;
    color: var(--indigo); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .project-title {
    font-size: 36px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--slate);
    letter-spacing: -1px; line-height: 1.1;
  }
  .project-title span { color: var(--indigo); }
  .project-sub {
    font-size: 15px; color: var(--mid); margin-top: 10px; max-width: 520px; line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .header-links { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 24px; }
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
    border: 1.5px solid; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s;
  }
  .btn-primary { background: var(--indigo); color: #fff; border-color: var(--indigo); }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; text-decoration: none; }
  .btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--slate); border-color: var(--border); }
  .btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--indigo); color: var(--indigo); text-decoration: none; }

  /* status badges */
  .badges { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 20px; }
  .badge {
    display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 99px;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }
  .badge-indigo { background: var(--indigo-light); color: var(--indigo); }
  .badge-emerald { background: var(--emerald-light); color: var(--emerald); }
  .badge-amber { background: var(--amber-light); color: var(--amber); }
  .badge-violet { background: var(--violet-light); color: var(--violet); }
  .badge-grey { background: var(--surface); color: var(--mid); border: 1px solid var(--border); }

  /* animated waveform header visual */
  .wave-container {
    width: 100%; height: 72px; overflow: hidden;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eef2ff 0%, #f5f3ff 100%);
    border-radius: 10px; margin-top: 28px; position: relative;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .wave-container canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }

  /* ── STATS ROW ── */
  .stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 48px; }
  @media(max-width:600px) { .stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); } }
  .stat-card {
    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px 18px;
    transition: box-shadow .2s;
  }
  .stat-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.07); }
  .stat-num { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; }
  .stat-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--mid); margin-top: 6px; }

  /* ── SECTIONS ── */
  section { margin-bottom: 56px; }
  .section-header { margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .section-title {
    font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--slate);
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  }
  .section-title::after {
    content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--border);
  }
  .section-desc { font-size: 14px; color: var(--mid); margin-top: 6px; }

  /* ── ARCH CARDS ── */
  .arch-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 16px; }
  @media(max-width:640px) { .arch-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .arch-card {
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 22px;
    position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow .2s;
  }
  .arch-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }
  .arch-card::before {
    content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px;
  }
  .arch-card.indigo::before { background: var(--indigo); }
  .arch-card.emerald::before { background: var(--emerald); }
  .arch-card.violet::before { background: var(--violet); }
  .arch-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--slate); margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .arch-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--light); margin-bottom: 12px; font-family: monospace; }
  .arch-body { font-size: 13px; color: var(--mid); line-height: 1.6; }

  /* ── COMPARE TABLE ── */
  .compare-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; margin-top: 20px; }
  .compare-table th {
    background: var(--surface); color: var(--mid); font-weight: 600;
    padding: 11px 14px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
    font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }
  .compare-table td { padding: 11px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .compare-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
  .compare-table tr:hover td { background: var(--surface); }
  .hi { color: var(--indigo); font-weight: 600; }
  .good { color: var(--emerald); font-weight: 700; }
  .warn { color: var(--amber); font-weight: 600; }

  /* ── PIPELINE SVG ── */
  .pipeline-wrap {
    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .pipeline-wrap svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }

  /* ── CHARTS ── */
  .charts-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  @media(max-width:640px) { .charts-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .chart-wrap {
    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden;
    transition: box-shadow .2s;
  }
  .chart-wrap:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.07); }
  .chart-wrap img { width: 100%; display: block; }
  .chart-label {
    padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--mid);
    font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .chart-full { margin-top: 16px; }
  .chart-full .chart-wrap { max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto; }

  /* ── OBSERVATION ── */
  .observation {
    background: #fffbeb; border: 1px solid #fde68a;
    border-left: 3px solid var(--amber); border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
    padding: 16px 20px; margin-top: 20px; font-size: 13px;
    color: #92400e; line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .observation strong { color: #78350f; }

  /* ── STEPS ── */
  .steps { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
  .step {
    display: flex; gap: 20px; padding: 20px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .step:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .step-num {
    min-width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--indigo-light); color: var(--indigo);
    font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .step-content { font-size: 14px; padding-top: 4px; }
  .step-content strong { color: var(--slate); display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .step-content p { color: var(--mid); font-size: 13px; }

  /* ── LIMITATIONS ── */
  .limits { list-style: none; }
  .limits li {
    padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    font-size: 13px; color: var(--mid); display: flex; gap: 10px;
  }
  .limits li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .limits li::before { content: "—"; color: var(--light); flex-shrink: 0; }

  /* ── FOOTER ── */
  .footer {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 28px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--mid);
  }
  .footer-links { display: flex; gap: 16px; }

  /* ── ANIMATED COUNTER ── */
  .counting { display: inline-block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">

  <!-- ── HEADER ── -->
  <header class="header">
    <div class="header-top">
      <div>
        <p class="project-label">Research Project · October 2026</p>
        <h1 class="project-title">SIGNAL <span>//</span> INDIC</h1>
        <p class="project-sub">
          Comparing Moshi and SALMONN-omni to understand what stops Speech LLMs from achieving
          low-latency, natural, real-time conversations — with a practical Hindi/Kannada ASR evaluation.
        </p>
        <div class="header-links">
          <a href="https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1GqasiGGlLbPUYyKf6NDzyu1l1kQ9VLwr?usp=sharing"
             class="btn btn-primary">▶ Open Notebook</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/vrbeirer/indic-speech-llm-latency-lab" class="btn btn-outline">GitHub</a>
        </div>
        <div class="badges" style="margin-top:16px;">
          <span class="badge badge-indigo">Hindi · Kannada</span>
          <span class="badge badge-emerald">100 Test Utterances</span>
          <span class="badge badge-violet">WER · CER · Latency</span>
          <span class="badge badge-amber">Experiments Complete</span>
          <span class="badge badge-grey">Controller: Prototype</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- animated waveform -->
    <div class="wave-container">
      <canvas id="waveCanvas"></canvas>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- ── STATS ROW ── -->
  <div class="stats">
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="stat-num" style="color:var(--indigo);">
        <span class="counting" data-target="4.0" data-suffix="%" data-decimals="1">0%</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-label">Hindi WER — specialist model</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="stat-num" style="color:var(--emerald);">
        <span class="counting" data-target="6.6" data-suffix="%" data-decimals="1">0%</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-label">Kannada WER — specialist model</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="stat-num" style="color:var(--amber);">
        <span class="counting" data-target="100" data-suffix="" data-decimals="0">0</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-label">Test utterances (50 Hindi + 50 Kannada)</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="stat-num" style="color:var(--violet);">
        <span class="counting" data-target="7" data-suffix="/7" data-decimals="0">0/7</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-label">Controller unit tests passing</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ── RESEARCH QUESTION ── -->
  <section>
    <div class="section-header">
      <h2 class="section-title">Research Question</h2>
    </div>
    <div style="background:var(--indigo-light);border-left:3px solid var(--indigo);border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;padding:18px 22px;font-size:15px;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;">
      What architectural limitations prevent Speech LLMs from achieving low-latency, natural, real-time conversations?
    </div>

    <div class="arch-cards" style="margin-top:20px;">
      <div class="arch-card indigo">
        <div class="arch-name">Moshi</div>
        <div class="arch-meta">~200 ms reported latency · Kyutai</div>
        <div class="arch-body">Joint codec-based speech and text modelling. Mimi encodes audio into 8 RVQ codebooks that flow directly into a hierarchical Temporal + Depth Transformer. Turn-taking is learned from joint audio behaviour — no explicit state tokens. Requires 7M+ hours of training audio.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="arch-card emerald">
        <div class="arch-name">SALMONN-omni</div>
        <div class="arch-meta">405 ms avg TTFA · NeurIPS 2025</div>
        <div class="arch-body">No audio codec tokens in the LLM. A Mamba streaming encoder feeds Llama-3-8B-Instruct via MLP adapter; CosyVoice2 handles synthesis. Explicit &lt;think&gt; / &lt;shift&gt; tokens control turn transitions — more interpretable but adds a structural latency floor.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="arch-card violet">
        <div class="arch-name">Our Proposal</div>
        <div class="arch-meta">Research hypothesis · prototype</div>
        <div class="arch-body">Adaptive controller conditioned on acoustic context <strong>xₜ</strong>, semantic-completeness confidence <strong>cₜ</strong>, and latency budget <strong>bₜ</strong>. Four actions: respond · keep listening · continue speaking · yield. All 7 synthetic unit tests pass.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="compare-table" style="margin-top:28px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Dimension</th>
          <th>Moshi</th>
          <th>SALMONN-omni</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td>Speech encoder</td>
          <td>Mimi codec — 12.5 Hz, 8 RVQ codebooks</td>
          <td>Mamba streaming — 25 Hz, distilled from Whisper-large-v3</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td>LLM alignment</td>
          <td>Direct token injection, joint training from scratch</td>
          <td>MLP adapter + LoRA rank 32 on Llama-3-8B-Instruct</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td>Turn-taking</td>
          <td>Emergent from joint audio modelling</td>
          <td>Explicit &lt;think&gt; / &lt;shift&gt; state tokens</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td>Reported latency</td>
          <td class="hi">~200 ms (paper, specific setup)</td>
          <td>~405 ms avg TTFA (paper, specific setup)</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td>Training data</td>
          <td>7M+ audio hours</td>
          <td>~730k ASR samples + ~80k dialogue</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--light);margin-top:8px;">Latency figures use different evaluation setups — not a direct speed comparison.</p>
  </section>

  <!-- ── PIPELINE ── -->
  <section>
    <div class="section-header">
      <h2 class="section-title">System Architecture</h2>
      <p class="section-desc">Top: the actual ASR experiment. Bottom: proposed adaptive controller (research design — unit tests only).</p>
    </div>
    <div class="pipeline-wrap">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 960 460" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif">
        <rect width="960" height="460" fill="#f8fafc"/>

        <!-- TOP LABEL -->
        <text x="480" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#94a3b8" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="1.5">EXPERIMENT — INDIC ASR EVALUATION</text>

        <!-- Row 1 boxes -->
        <rect x="20" y="42" width="130" height="60" rx="8" fill="white" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="85" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" font-weight="600">Speech Input</text>
        <text x="85" y="81" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">Hindi · Kannada</text>
        <text x="85" y="94" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">FLEURS (50+50)</text>

        <line x1="152" y1="72" x2="188" y2="72" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a-grey)"/>

        <rect x="190" y="42" width="145" height="60" rx="8" fill="white" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="262" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" font-weight="600">ASR Model</text>
        <text x="262" y="81" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#4f46e5">Baseline: Whisper-small</text>
        <text x="262" y="94" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#059669">Specialist: large-v2/med</text>

        <line x1="337" y1="72" x2="373" y2="72" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a-grey)"/>

        <rect x="375" y="42" width="130" height="60" rx="8" fill="white" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="440" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" font-weight="600">Transcript</text>
        <text x="440" y="81" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">lang-constrained</text>
        <text x="440" y="94" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">decoding</text>

        <line x1="507" y1="72" x2="543" y2="72" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a-grey)"/>

        <rect x="545" y="42" width="135" height="60" rx="8" fill="white" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="612" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" font-weight="600">Evaluation</text>
        <text x="612" y="81" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#059669">WER · CER</text>
        <text x="612" y="94" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#059669">Latency · RTF</text>

        <line x1="682" y1="72" x2="718" y2="72" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a-green)"/>

        <rect x="720" y="42" width="130" height="60" rx="8" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="785" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#059669" font-weight="700">Results ✓</text>
        <text x="785" y="81" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#065f46">WER 0.040 Hindi</text>
        <text x="785" y="94" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#065f46">WER 0.066 Kannada</text>

        <!-- Divider -->
        <line x1="20" y1="135" x2="940" y2="135" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="5,4"/>

        <!-- BOTTOM LABEL -->
        <text x="480" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#7c3aed" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="1.5">PROPOSAL — ADAPTIVE TURN-TRANSITION CONTROLLER</text>
        <text x="480" y="173" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">Research design · synthetic unit tests only</text>

        <!-- Row 2 boxes -->
        <rect x="20" y="188" width="120" height="56" rx="8" fill="white" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="80" y="210" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" font-weight="600">User Audio</text>
        <text x="80" y="226" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">streaming</text>
        <text x="80" y="238" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">80 ms blocks</text>

        <line x1="142" y1="216" x2="178" y2="216" stroke="#c4b5fd" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a-violet)"/>

        <rect x="180" y="188" width="130" height="56" rx="8" fill="white" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="245" y="210" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" font-weight="600">Speech Encoder</text>
        <text x="245" y="226" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">acoustic context xₜ</text>
        <text x="245" y="238" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">embeddings</text>

        <!-- branches down -->
        <line x1="245" y1="244" x2="245" y2="265" stroke="#c4b5fd" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,2"/>
        <line x1="245" y1="265" x2="155" y2="265" stroke="#c4b5fd" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,2"/>
        <line x1="155" y1="265" x2="155" y2="280" stroke="#c4b5fd" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,2" marker-end="url(#a-violet)"/>
        <line x1="245" y1="265" x2="500" y2="265" stroke="#c4b5fd" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,2"/>
        <line x1="500" y1="265" x2="500" y2="246" stroke="#c4b5fd" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,2" marker-end="url(#a-violet)"/>

        <rect x="70" y="282" width="170" height="52" rx="8" fill="white" stroke="#c4b5fd" stroke-width="1.2"/>
        <text x="155" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#7c3aed" font-weight="600">Semantic Confidence cₜ</text>
        <text x="155" y="318" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">lightweight aux model</text>
        <text x="155" y="330" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">utterance completeness</text>

        <rect x="268" y="282" width="140" height="52" rx="8" fill="white" stroke="#c4b5fd" stroke-width="1.2"/>
        <text x="338" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#7c3aed" font-weight="600">Latency Budget bₜ</text>
        <text x="338" y="318" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">time elapsed</text>
        <text x="338" y="330" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">remaining deadline</text>

        <line x1="155" y1="334" x2="155" y2="355" stroke="#c4b5fd" stroke-width="1" marker-end="url(#a-violet)"/>
        <line x1="338" y1="334" x2="338" y2="355" stroke="#c4b5fd" stroke-width="1" marker-end="url(#a-violet)"/>

        <!-- Controller -->
        <rect x="415" y="188" width="170" height="64" rx="8" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>

        <tr><td>Hindi</td><td class="good">Specialist (large-v2)</td><td class="good">0.040</td><td class="good">0.020</td><td>21.1 s</td><td>1.97</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Kannada</td><td style="color:var(--mid)">Whisper-small baseline</td><td class="warn">2.057</td><td class="warn">1.335</td><td>7.6 s</td><td>0.69</td></tr>

    <div class="observation">
      <strong>Accuracy vs. latency trade-off.</strong> Specialist models cut WER by ~13× for Hindi and ~31× for Kannada relative to the Whisper-small baseline. The cost: inference time jumped from 2–8 s up to 21–23 s per sample because the specialist models are substantially larger (RTF &gt; 1, so not real-time without GPU acceleration or quantisation). The Kannada baseline also showed severe hallucination — repeated syllable loops — a known Whisper-small failure mode on lower-resource languages, which explains the WER above 2.0.
    </div>

<script>
// ── Animated waveform header ──────────────────────────────────────────────
const canvas = document.getElementById('waveCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

function resize() {
  canvas.width  = canvas.offsetWidth  * devicePixelRatio;
  canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight * devicePixelRatio;
  ctx.scale(devicePixelRatio, devicePixelRatio);
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

let t = 0;
function drawWave() {
  const W = canvas.offsetWidth, H = canvas.offsetHeight;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // draw 2 overlapping sine waves
  const waves = [
    { amp: H*0.28, freq: 0.018, speed: 1.2, color: 'rgba(79,70,229,0.35)', width: 2   },
    { amp: H*0.18, freq: 0.026, speed: 0.8, color: 'rgba(124,58,237,0.25)', width: 1.5 },
    { amp: H*0.12, freq: 0.034, speed: 1.6, color: 'rgba(5,150,105,0.20)',  width: 1   },
  ];

  waves.forEach(w => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = w.color;
    ctx.lineWidth   = w.width;
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x++) {
      const y = H/2 + Math.sin(x * w.freq + t * w.speed) * w.amp
                     * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(x * 0.004 + t * 0.3));
      x === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  });

  t += 0.04;
  requestAnimationFrame(drawWave);
}
drawWave();

// ── Counting animation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function animateCount(el) {
  const target   = parseFloat(el.dataset.target);
  const suffix   = el.dataset.suffix   || '';
  const decimals = parseInt(el.dataset.decimals || '0');
  let current = 0;
  const step = target / 60;

  const tick = () => {
    current = Math.min(current + step, target);
    el.textContent = current.toFixed(decimals) + suffix;
    if (current < target) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  tick();
}

const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  entries.forEach(e => {
    if (e.isIntersecting) {
      animateCount(e.target);
      observer.unobserve(e.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.5 });

document.querySelectorAll('.counting').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

// ── Card hover lift ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.querySelectorAll('.arch-card, .stat-card').forEach(card => {
  card.style.transition = 'transform .2s, box-shadow .2s';
  card.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
    card.style.transform  = 'translateY(-2px)';
    card.style.boxShadow  = '0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.10)';
  });
  card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
    card.style.transform  = '';
    card.style.boxShadow  = '';
  });
});
</script>
